text: [33] katīhi nu kho bhante dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbanti . dasahi kho upāli dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbaṃ katamehi dasahi idhupāli bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā pātimokkhaṃ kho panassa vitthārena svāgataṃ hoti suvibhattaṃ suppavattaṃ suvinicchitaṃ suttaso anubyañjanaso paṭibalo hoti gilānaṃ upaṭṭhātuṃ vā upaṭṭhāpetuṃ vā paṭibalo hoti anabhiratiṃ vūpakāsetuṃ vā vūpakāsāpetuṃ vā paṭibalo hoti uppannaṃ kukkuccaṃ dhammato vinodetuṃ paṭibalo hoti uppannaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ dhammato vivecetuṃ paṭibalo hoti adhisīle samādapetuṃ paṭibalo hoti adhicitte samādapetuṃ paṭibalo hoti adhipaññāya samādapetuṃ imehi kho upāli dasahi dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbanti .
